items.titleZh: 林德布拉德西班牙站FP2撞车后称“我允许自己犯错”
items.summaryZh: F1西班牙大奖赛FP2中，新秀Arvid Lindblad驾驶小红牛赛车在马德里赛道赛道13号左弯撞车，右侧VCARB 03受损，提前结束周五练习。尽管如此，他仍以第10名完成排位，赛后为自己犯错的权利辩护，并表示由于需要更换底盘，情况受到影响。

items.originalTitle: 林德布拉德西班牙站FP2撞车后称“我允许自己犯错”
items.summaryEn: In FP2 at the Spanish Grand Prix, rookie Arvid Lindblad crashed his Racing Bulls car at Turn 13 of the Madring circuit, damaging the right-hand side of the VCARB 03 and ending his Friday running early. Despite this, he qualified 10th and defended his right to make mistakes, noting that a chassis change affected his weekend.
detailZh: 在马德里赛道 F1撞车后，Arvid Lindblad坚称：“我允许自己犯错”
林德布拉德在马德里赛道的FP2中发生严重撞车，但再次恢复并进入Q3
在F1西班牙大奖赛FP2中撞车后，毫无歉意的Arvid Lindblad捍卫了自己犯错的权利——这并未阻止这位新秀以第10名完成排位。
林德布拉德在马德里赛道赛道13号左弯失控，驾驶小红牛赛车撞车，撞击损坏了VCARB 03的右侧。这结束了他周五的练习，由于需要更换底盘，他在FP3结束时仅完成了7圈。
然而，这位英裔瑞典车手在Q1中仍与临时队友角田裕毅的速度相当，随后在Q2中以0.9秒的优势击败他，抢得排位赛前十的一席。
当被问及撞车是否打击了他的信心时，林德布拉德解释道：“更大的问题是我没有在FP3中驾驶，你知道吗？如果我完成了整个FP3，我认为这不会对我造成太大伤害。但现实是，我撞车了，然后在FP3中只完成了两圈[飞驰圈]，我并没有真正有机会重新适应。这才是伤害我的地方。”
“现实是我们错过了——我不想说‘两节学习时间’，但由于撞车，我们在FP2后无法舒适地做出改变。然后我们在FP3中没有正常驾驶，所以我们不想做出改变。所以我们基本上只用了FP1来调整设置。我的设置与FP1后决定的相同。”
“我绝对认为，如果我昨天没有撞车，通往排位的轨迹会非常不同，我会高兴得多。”
林德布拉德并不回避他的撞车让周末变得更加棘手的事实，但他坚称这样的错误对于F1历史上第四年轻的车手来说是意料之中的。
“事情就是这样，这是需要学习的东西，”他说。“我不会因为撞车而自责，因为这是不可避免的。”
“今年我一直处于极限，我一直非常快。这是我本赛季第10次进入Q3[不包括冲刺赛]。我允许自己犯错。我会从中学习。”
林德布拉德的稳定性实际上非常出色，他尚未在大奖赛中退赛——尽管由于离合器故障，他在蒙特利尔未能起步。他在过去8轮中的7轮得分，连续9次进入Q3，并且自银石冲刺赛以来未被队友在排位中击败。
因此，这位小红牛车手的速度同样令人印象深刻，他在FP2中获得第四名，尽管早早撞车。这是否展示了本可能发生的情况？
“我今天不会成为P4，”他笑道。“我的意思是，我无法再快一秒。”
“顶级车队显然取得了进步。现实是也许我们的人只是在起始设置上做得更好，所以我们起步更接近。”
“所以这就是我们应得的位置。现实是昨天很特别。我认为我领先于曲线，车队也领先于曲线。但无法掩盖我们不是P4的事实。所以现实是明天我们会尽力而为。但P9，除非有人撞车，否则是最好的可能。”
detailEn: After Madring F1 crash, Arvid Lindblad insists: “I'm allowed to make mistakes”
Lindblad had a substantial shunt in FP2 at Madring, but recovered to reach Q3 yet again
An unapologetic Arvid Lindblad has defended his right to make mistakes after crashing out of FP2 at Formula 1’s Spanish Grand Prix – which didn’t prevent the rookie from qualifying 10th.

Lindblad lost control of his Racing Bulls in Madring’s Turn 13 left-hander, with the impact damaging the right-hand side of the VCARB 03. This ended his Friday running and, with a chassis change required, he completed just seven laps at the end of FP3.
Yet, the Anglo-Swede still matched interim team-mate Yuki Tsunoda’s pace in Q1, then beat him by 0.9s in Q2 to snatch a spot in the top 10 of qualifying.

Asked about his confidence being knocked down by the crash, Lindblad explained: “The bigger thing was just that I didn't drive in FP3, you know? If I had done all of FP3, I don't think it really would have hurt me too much. But the reality was, I had the crash and then I only did two [flying] laps in FP3 and I didn't really get a chance to get comfortable again. And that was the thing that hurt me.

“The reality is we missed – I don't want to say ‘two sessions of learning’, but we weren't comfortable making a change after FP2 because of the crash. Then we didn't drive properly in FP3, so we didn't want to make a change. So we basically only used FP1 for the set-up. I have the same set-up as what we decided after FP1.
“I definitely think that if I hadn't had that crash yesterday, the trajectory to quali would have been very different and I would have been a lot happier.”
Lindblad doesn’t shy away from the fact his shunt made his weekend a lot trickier, but he’s adamant such mistakes are to be expected from F1’s fourth-youngest driver in history.
“It is what it is, it's something to learn from,” he said. “I'm not going to beat myself up for crashing, because it's something that's inevitable.
“I've been so on the limit this year, I've been so fast. It's my 10th Q3 of the season [excluding sprints]. I'm allowed to make mistakes. I'm going to learn from it.”

Lindblad’s consistency has actually been remarkable, as he’s yet to retire from a grand prix – though he failed to start the race Montreal race due to a clutch failure. He has scored points in seven of the last eight rounds, is on a nine-time Q3 streak, and hasn’t been outqualified by a team-mate since the Silverstone sprint.
So the Racing Bulls racer’s pace has been equally impressive, as shown by his fourth place in FP2, which he clinched despite crashing out early. Does that show what could have been?
“I wasn't going to be P4 today,” he chuckled. “I mean, I can't go one second quicker.
“The top teams obviously made a step. The reality is maybe our guys just did a better job with the starting set-up, so we started closer.

“So this is where we deserve to be. The reality is yesterday was something special. I think I was ahead of the curve, the team was also ahead of the curve. But there's no hiding the fact that we're not P4. So the reality is tomorrow we're going to try to do the best we can. But P9, unless someone crashes, it's the best that's possible.”
keyPointsZh: 林德布拉德在FP3仅完成7圈，Q1与队友角田裕毅速度相当，Q2快0.9秒晋级Q3。
由于撞车，车队未在FP2后调整设置，FP3也未正常驾驶，基本只用了FP1的设置。
林德布拉德本赛季尚未退赛，最近8场7次得分，连续9次进入Q3，自银石冲刺赛以来未被队友在排位中击败。
keyPointsEn: Lindblad completed only seven laps in FP3, matched teammate Yuki Tsunoda's pace in Q1, and beat him by 0.9s in Q2 to reach Q3.
Due to the crash, the team did not make setup changes after FP2 and did not drive properly in FP3, so they essentially only used FP1 for the setup.

Lindblad has yet to retire from a grand prix this season, scored points in seven of the last eight rounds, is on a nine-time Q3 streak, and hasn't been outqualified by a teammate since the Silverstone sprint.

items.titleZh: 西班牙大奖赛F1排位赛：赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: 在马德里赛道赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛排位赛中，诺里斯以0.011秒优势夺得杆位，皮亚斯特里表现挣扎，多位车手命运各异。

media.altZh: 西班牙大奖赛F1排位赛：赢家与输家

items.originalTitle: 西班牙大奖赛F1排位赛：赢家与输家
items.summaryEn: In the first-ever Formula 1 qualifying at the Madring, Lando Norris took pole position by just 0.011s, while Oscar Piastri struggled and several other drivers experienced mixed fortunes.
detailZh: 在马德里赛道赛道举行的史上首场F1排位赛中，第一名和第二名仅相差0.011秒，西班牙大奖赛发车格的前四个位置也将由来自四支不同车队的车手占据。
但考虑到所有关于周日正赛变成巡游的担忧，这是行动的终结吗？
如果是的话，谁最大化了机会，谁又显得力不从心？
Q1第八，Q2第九……皮亚斯特里整个排位赛都远远不在节奏上。
他不得不放弃了Q1的第一个飞驰圈，从那之后，用他自己的话说，这是一场“混乱”的排位赛。
他甚至称Q3的表现“相当糟糕”，他艰难地只拿到第七。
“有时候就是这样，很不幸，”他说。“这个周末好一些，像蒙扎一样，至少我……对赛车的表现更满意了，今天只是那种日子之一。”
更痛苦的是，这里预计很难超车。而更更痛苦的是，队友兰多·诺里斯夺得了惊人的杆位——所以速度绝对是有的。
皮亚斯特里的平庸表现仍在继续。——萨马斯·卡纳尔
赢家不仅因为最终结果，还因为取得结果的方式——几乎是从天而降。
排位赛早期阶段表明这将是梅赛德斯和法拉利之间的较量，马克斯·维斯塔潘的红牛或许会插一脚。
诺里斯Q1第五，但Q2仅第七，当基米·安东内利以周末首个1分31秒圈速为梅赛德斯拿下临时杆位，随后在Q3第一轮被刘易斯·汉密尔顿以微弱优势超越时，看起来排位赛将按预期发展。
但随后诺里斯来了，驾驶他的迈凯伦完成了一圈全力冲刺、极其投入的飞驰圈。
最后一个弯不够整洁——车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉认为诺里斯在那里损失了0.3秒——但斯特拉称其余部分“杰作”，而诺里斯认为这可能是他整个职业生涯中最好的排位圈，足以以百分之一秒的优势从安东内利手中抢走杆位。
这位世界冠军的表现并非完全干净，但无疑精彩。——本·安德森
与安东内利的速度差距：0.314秒（不太好）
与安东内利的排名差距：四位（也不太好）
拉塞尔似乎轻松摆脱了Q1擦墙的阴影，他在Q1排名第一，赛后表示感觉良好——声称在Q3最后一圈中途，他比之前的最佳成绩“快了约0.3秒”。
“在11号弯尝试推得太狠，轮胎承受不住，之后损失了所有圈速，”拉塞尔说，并补充说判断对轮胎施加多大压力“真的很有挑战性”。
挽回那0.3秒左右的损失显然会改变他的发车位置。但在这个有希望的周末开局之后，排位赛再次表明拉塞尔在梅赛德斯落后一步——目前几乎无法抓住任何争冠希望。——杰克·科曾斯
汉密尔顿仅以0.006秒的优势在排位赛中击败法拉利队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔，并在FP3撞车损失时间后，成功夺得第二排发车位。
这位七届冠军在赛后给出了简短的总结，他回忆排位赛“相当直接”，并称赞车队“执行出色”。
“我会享受乐趣，我只能这么说，我会真正享受乐趣，我不会给自己太大压力，”他说。
勒克莱尔在蒙扎撞车后使用的是旧规格法拉利引擎，他说尤其在一号赛段损失了时间。
“我认为大多数人在排位赛中都使用了新动力单元或更新的规格，而我基本还是同样的规格——这显然是我上周的责任——所以也许我没有像其他人那样在那方面取得进步，”他说。
“但话虽如此，我认为那一圈相当干净。我在这里那里有一些小失误，可能损失了一点，当我看到差距如此之近时，很沮丧，但与此同时，我觉得如果你问今天发车格上的任何车手，每个人可能都能在圈中找到一些东西。”
在意大利大奖赛起步时的冲突之后，法拉利车手在本场马德里比赛起步时将再次成为焦点。——SK
贝尔曼的马德里周末在周六上午崩溃，他在FP3末尾于10号弯撞车。
那次撞车使他无缘排位赛，并暂时排在发车格第21位。
痛苦的是——哈斯队友埃斯特班·奥康排在第13位。
“现在站在这里很遗憾，”贝尔曼在排位赛期间旁观时说。“赛车很快。昨天是艰难的一天，但我们过夜做了一些调整，FP3中赛车感觉真的很好。
“不幸的是，我在最后一圈的10号弯被坑了。”
他说轮胎磨损和一阵风导致了他的失误。
周日可能是贝尔曼连续第九场大奖赛无积分，也是哈斯连续第八场，而奥迪在争夺制造商第七名的战斗中继续蚕食其优势。——SK
红牛又一次典型的周五到周六逆转，当时技术总监皮埃尔·瓦什表示他的车队需要在调校、机械抓地力、行驶质量和能量部署方面努力，才能让维斯塔潘处于更好的位置。
这位四届冠军在FP3中已经接近，仅落后不到0.4秒，到了排位赛他完全进入竞争：Q1落后0.170秒（队友利亚姆·劳森圈速与拉塞尔的梅赛德斯相差不到0.1秒），然后在Q2全场最快。
维斯塔潘是Q3中仅有的三位跑进1分32秒的车手之一，足以让他排在发车格第三，领先两辆法拉利、一辆梅赛德斯和一辆迈凯伦，而劳森则滑落至第八。
维斯塔潘将功劳归于赛车终于在弯道中做到了他想要的事情，但很难不觉得最终还有一点马克斯的魔力在起作用。——BA
困惑且不解。这是对加斯利排位赛结束时的最佳描述。
“有些事情说不通，”他在排位赛第14名后哀叹道，在Q2中落后阿尔派队友弗兰科·科拉平托0.7秒，这很不寻常。
detailEn: Just 0.011s separate first and second in the first-ever Formula 1 qualifying session at the Madring, and the first four slots on the Spanish Grand Prix grid will be occupied by drivers from four different teams too.
But considering all the fears of a Sunday procession, is this the end of the action?
And if it is, who's maximised their opportunity, and who's been found wanting?
Eighth in Q1, ninth in Q2...Piastri was well off the pace throughout qualifying.
He had to abort his first flying lap of Q1 and, from then on, it was a "messy" session by his reckoning.
He even called it a "pretty crap" go in Q3, as he laboured to seventh.

"That's how it goes sometimes unfortunately," he said. "It's been a bit of a better weekend, like Monza, in that I at least am...happier with what the car's doing, and today was simply just one of those sessions."

More painful will be the fact that it's expected to be hard to overtake here. And even more painful will be the fact that team-mate Lando Norris took a stunning pole position - so the pace was definitely there.
Piastri's middling run continues. - Samarth Kanal
A winner not just because of the end result, but because of the manner in which it arrived - pretty much out of nowhere.
The earlier stages of qualifying suggested this would be a fight between Mercedes and Ferrari, with Max Verstappen's Red Bull maybe interloping.

Norris was fifth in Q1 but only seventh in Q2, and when Kimi Antonelli stuck his Mercedes on provisional pole with the first 1m31s lap of the weekend, having been narrowly usurped by Lewis Hamilton in the first Q3 runs, it looked at though the session was going to form.
But then came Norris, with a full-send, ultra-committed lap in his McLaren.

The last corner was untidy - team principal Andrea Stella reckoned Norris lost three tenths there - but the rest of it Stella called "a masterpiece", and what Norris reckoned was probably the best qualifying lap of his entire career was enough to snatch pole from Antonelli by a hundredth of a second.
Not totally clean from the world champion, but certainly brilliant. - Ben Anderson
Gap to Antonelli in pace: 0.314s (not great)
Gap to Antonelli in positions: four (also not great)

Russell seemed shake off his brush with the wall in Q1, a session he ended up topping, pretty easily and said he felt in a good place afterwards - claiming he was "about three tenths up" on his previous best midway round his final Q3 lap.
"Tried pushing hard in Turn 11, the tyres couldn't take it and then lost all the laptime thereafter," said Russell, who added it has been "really challenging" to judge how hard to lean on the tyres.

Salvaging a time loss in that three-tenth ballpark obviously would've made a difference to his grid position. But after a promising start to the weekend, qualifying was another example of Russell being a step behind at Mercedes - and barely being able to grasp at any title hopes right now. - Jack Cozens
Hamilton outqualified Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc by just 0.006s and did well to take a place on the second row after crashing and losing time in FP3.
The seven-time champion delivered a terse post-qualifying summary as he recalled a "pretty straightforward" session and praised "good execution" from the team.
"I'm going to have fun, that's all I can say, I’m going to have real fun, I'm not going to put too much pressure on it," he said.
Leclerc, who is using an older-spec Ferrari engine after his Monza crash, said he lost time through sector one in particular.

"I think most of the people put a new power unit or a newer-spec [in for qualifying], and I kind of had the same spec - and that's on me obviously for last week - so maybe I didn't do the step forward that the others did on that side," he said.

"But having said that I think the lap was quite clean. I've had a few moments here and there, which I maybe lost a little bit and when I see how close it is, it's frustrating but at the same time I feel like if you ask any drivers on the grid today, everybody probably can find something on the lap."
After their clash at the start of the Italian GP, the spotlight will again be on the Ferrari drivers at the start of this race in Madrid. - SK
Bearman's Madrid weekend unravelled on Saturday morning when he crashed at Turn 10 right at the end of FP3.
That crash ruled him out of qualifying and put him a provisional 21st on the grid.
Painful - as Haas team-mate Esteban Ocon was up in 13th.

"It's a shame to be standing here right now," said Bearman as he stood watching on from the sidelines in qualifying. "The car was quick. Yesterday was a tough day but we made some changes overnight and the car was feeling really good in FP3.
"Unfortunately I got caught out in Turn 10 on that final lap."
He said worn tyres and a gust of wind contributed to his mistake.
Sunday could be Bearman's ninth-straight grand prix without points, and Haas's eighth, as Audi continues to chip away at its advantage in the fight for seventh in the constructors' championship. - SK

Another typical Red Bull turnaround from Friday, when technical director Pierre Wache indicated his team needed to work on set-up, mechanical grip, ride quality and energy deployment in order to get Verstappen into a better position.

The four-time champion was knocking on the door in FP3, just under four tenths off the pace, and come qualifying he was right in the mix: 0.170s off the pace in Q1 (where team-mate Liam Lawson lapped within a tenth of Russell's Mercedes) then fastest of all in Q2.
Verstappen was one of only three drivers to lap below 1m32s in Q3, enough to place him third on the grid and ahead of both Ferraris, a Mercedes and a McLaren, while Lawson faded to eighth.

Verstappen credited the car for finally doing what he wanted it to in the corners, but it's hard to escape the feeling there was also a bit of Max magic in play to make the difference in the end. - BA
Baffled and bemused. That's how best to describe Gasly at the end of qualifying.
"Something doesn't add up," he lamented after qualifying 14th, an uncharacteristic seven tenths off Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto in Q2.
keyPointsZh: 诺里斯在Q3最后一圈从安东内利手中抢走杆位，差距仅0.01秒，前四名来自四支不同车队。
皮亚斯特里整个排位赛节奏不佳，Q1第八、Q2第九，最终仅列第七，自称Q3表现“相当糟糕”。
贝尔曼在FP3末尾于10号弯撞车，无缘排位赛，正赛将从第21位起步。
keyPointsEn: Norris snatched pole from Antonelli on his final Q3 lap by just 0.01s, with the top four grid slots occupied by drivers from four different teams.
Piastri was off the pace throughout qualifying, eighth in Q1 and ninth in Q2, ultimately qualifying seventh and calling his Q3 run 'pretty crap'.
Bearman crashed at Turn 10 at the end of FP3, ruling him out of qualifying and leaving him provisionally 21st on the grid.

detailZh: 诺里斯在F1新马德里马德里赛道赛道举办的首届西班牙大奖赛中获得杆位，领先于F1锦标赛领跑者安东内利。
Antonelli不需要像上次在蒙扎那样从后排冲到前排，不过考虑到这条新临时赛道的特性以及看起来很难超车，这可能无论如何都很困难。
大多数车手都规矩行事，排位赛中没有出现红旗，尽管有人担心这条赛道会导致频繁撞车。
但有几项发车格罚退需要计入：塞恩斯因在Q1阻挡Valtteri Bottas被罚退三位，斯特罗尔因使用全新的本田动力单元被罚退40位，该动力单元在他做出成绩前就出现了漏水，而Ollie Bearman将在他的哈斯车队更换了多个动力单元部件后从维修区起步。
detailEn: Lando Norris claimed pole position for the first Spanish Grand Prix to be held on Formula 1's new Madring circuit in Madrid, ahead of F1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

Antonelli won't need to blast from the back to the front like he did last time out at Monza, though that may be difficult anyway given the nature of this new temporary circuit and how hard it looks to overtake on.
Most drivers behaved themselves and there were no red flags in qualifying, despite fears this track would lead to frequent crashes.

But there were a couple of grid penalties to account for: Carlos Sainz drops three places for impeding Valtteri Bottas in Q1, Lance Stroll has a 40-place penalty for taking a completely new Honda power unit that promptly sprung a water leak before he could set a time, and Ollie Bearman will start from the pitlane after his Haas team changed a number of power unit components.

detailZh: 拉塞尔 解释了他如何在 马德里赛道 F1 排位赛中仅获得第六名
Russell 的争冠之路再遭打击，他在马德里排位赛中比队友 Antonelli 慢了四个名次
拉塞尔 解释了他在 F1 西班牙大奖赛排位赛中糟糕的表现，他最终仅获得第六名，而梅赛德斯队友兼争冠对手 安东内利 则获得第二名。
Russell 在马德里新街道赛道的 Q1 中跑出最快圈速，但在接下来两个阶段中未能像对手那样显著提升。他在 Q2 和 Q3 中均排名第六，比队友慢了约零点三秒。
但这会不会与拉塞尔在Q1中用左前轮擦到墙壁有关？那次擦墙的方式，与导致亚历山大·阿尔本在FP3因损坏而提前结束练习的事故非常相似。
“我不这么认为，因为我在Q1的下一圈更快，”这位英国车手告诉天空体育F1。
他在对文字媒体讲话时补充道：“显然，当时我有点担心，但赛车没问题。之后我在本节排位赛中跑出最快成绩，然后感觉就进入了竞争节奏。
“但就是最后一圈，我当时快了大约零点三秒，在11号弯尝试用力推进，轮胎承受不住，然后[我]就丢掉了之后所有的圈速。所以那有点烦人。”
“这是一条非常艰难的赛道，”他也对Sky表示。“你几乎需要以略低于极限的速度驾驶，然后再压榨出最后那一点，而今天这让我付出了代价。”
据梅赛德斯车队领队Toto Wolff称，Russell还因为在马德里赛道这条信心至关重要的赛道上进行了大量调校改动而受到影响。
“在排位赛中，后轴过热，雪上加霜，”Wolff对奥地利广播公司ORF表示。“之前并不是这样。
“他还在赛前拆掉了一些前翼，然后在赛中又装了回去。这样一来，你其实不太清楚赛车会有什么表现。通常，在街道赛道上，你需要一圈又一圈地跑才能更贴近护墙。改变调校显然对此没有帮助。”
考虑到 Russell 在车手积分榜上已经落后 Antonelli 66 分，他明天确实需要取得一个好成绩，那么他能在比赛中有所进展吗？
“我认为轮胎磨损无论如何都会决定比赛走向，”他告诉 Sky。“要么没有磨损，比赛变成一场列队巡游，要么磨损非常高，比赛会相当混乱。所以这肯定会是关键的时刻。”
补充报道：Jake Boxall-Legge
detailEn: George Russell explains how he ended up a lowly sixth in Madring F1 qualifying
Russell’s title bid takes another hit as he qualifies four spots behind team-mate Antonelli in Madrid
George Russell has explained his poor qualifying performance in Formula 1’s Spanish Grand Prix, having ended up a lowly sixth while Mercedes team-mate and title rival Kimi Antonelli took second.

Russell set the pace in Q1 at Madrid’s new street circuit but failed to improve as significantly as his opponents in the next two segments. He was sixth-quickest, some three tenths down on his team-mate, in both Q2 and Q3.
But could this be linked to Russell brushing the wall with his front-left tyre in Q1, in very similar way to the incident that ended Alex Albon’s running in FP3 due to damage?
“I don't think so, because my following lap in Q1 we were quicker,” the Briton told Sky Sports F1.
He added, speaking to the written press: “Obviously, I was slightly concerned in the moment, but the car was fine. I went out on top of the session afterwards and then felt in the mix thereafter.
“But just the last lap, I was about three tenths up, tried pushing hard in Turn 11, the tyres couldn’t take it, and then [I] lost all the lap time thereafter. So that was a bit annoying.”
“It's a really tough circuit,” he also told Sky. “You almost need to drive a little bit below the limit, then extract that last little bit, and that cost me today.”
According to Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff, Russell was also hindered by numerous set-up changes at a Madring track where confidence was key.
“In qualifying, the rear axle was overheating, on top of everything,” Wolff told Austrian broadcaster ORF. “That wasn't the case before.

“He also took some front wing off before the session, then put it back in during the session. And then you don't really know what to expect from the car. Normally, on street circuits, you need to drive lap after lap to get closer to the walls. Changing the set-up obviously doesn't help with that.”
Russell does need a good result tomorrow, given he’s already 66 points adrift of Antonelli in the drivers’ standings, so can he make progress in the race?

“I think tyre deg is going to define it one way or another,” he told Sky. “It will either be no deg, and there will be a procession, or there will be really high deg, and it will be pretty chaotic. So that's for sure going to be the big moment.”
Additional reporting by Jake Boxall-Legge

梅赛德斯的拉塞尔在令人失望的Q3后获得第六名，他告诉天空体育 F1：“我认为轮胎退化将以某种方式决定比赛。”

而积分榜领跑者安东内利，被诺里斯惊人的最后一圈抢走杆位，他预测：“可能前10圈会像老奶奶开车一样，但让我们看看。”
“我们在长距离跑中看到了退化有多陡峭，尤其是如果你过早发力。我们会尝试在当下观察。”
“也许我们进入比赛后，退化会低得多。”
为什么诺里斯尽管获得杆位却处于“劣势”
看起来赛道位置可能至关重要，所以理论上诺里斯处于最佳位置，他从杆位发车，领先于安东内利、维斯塔潘和汉密尔顿。
但是，这位迈凯伦车手因变速箱问题几乎错过了整个周五二练，因此没有完成任何有意义的长距离跑。
“我今晚必须做功课。从高油量角度看，我处于劣势。我一点都没跑，”诺里斯告诉天空体育 F1。
兰多·诺里斯描述他夺得西班牙大奖赛杆位的那一圈是他最好的圈速之一
“我需要利用我们从奥斯卡那里得到的数据，看看我能用哪些，查看车载视频和所有人的数据。”
“不是理想情况，但我给了自己最好的机会，我们会以最好的方式准备。幸运的是，这不是最适合超车的赛道，所以我们会专注于好的起步、好的第一圈，看看能做什么。”
在周五的练习赛中，由于连续高速弯道，包括轮胎承受高负荷的大倾角“La Monumental”12号弯，轮胎退化极其严重。
“每个人都发现轮胎上有很多起泡，”迈凯伦车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉说。
“我不确定每个人对我们面前有哪些策略都有清晰的想法，所以比赛会很有观赏性。”
“我认为如果坚持一停，想想摩纳哥，你可以开得很慢，管理轮胎，不让（大倾角）12号弯出现起泡。也许你可以延长轮胎寿命，让一停奏效。”
“但如果超车是可能的，由于轮胎高退化，你无法慢到足以让一停奏效。”
“现阶段我认为这会是一场两停比赛，一场充满变数的比赛。”
领先车手之间的速度应该很接近，所以比赛很可能归结为轮胎退化，这将决定有多少超车。
诺里斯处于最佳位置，因为他可以控制节奏，但如果超车是可能的，他不能为了保胎而开得太慢。但这是最大的问号，是否有足够的空间超车？
“你唯一能做的就是尝试给前车施加压力，试图让他们犯错或让他们多退化一点，然后你尝试玩策略，”安东内利说。

George Russell believes Formula 1's first race at the Madring could swing one of two extreme ways, while Lewis Hamilton admits he does not know what exactly to expect, heading into Sunday's Spanish Grand Prix.

The wall-lined circuit in Madrid has proved a big challenge for drivers so far on its inaugural weekend, while Friday's practice running showed up tyre degradation difficulties on long heavier-fuel runs.

The grid's leading drivers are braced for those challenges to continue into a 57-lap race for which McLaren's Lando Norris starts on pole position ahead of Mercedes' championship-leading Kimi Antonelli.

Mercedes' Russell, who qualified sixth after a disappointing Q3, told Sky Sports F1: "I think tyre degradation will define it one way or another.
"There will either be no degradation and it will be a procession, or really high degradation and it will be pretty chaotic."
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, who qualified fourth having initially held provisional pole after the first flying laps of Q3, is also expecting tyre management to play a central role.
"We all came into the weekend thinking there would not be much degradation and the tyres would last long but it turns out there was a lot of degradation [on Friday]," said Hamilton.
Lewis Hamilton reflects on his Spanish Grand Prix qualifying lap, which saw the Ferrari drive secure fourth.
"I'm sure that will improve as the car gets grippier, but I have no idea what to expect."
And championship leader Antonelli, who was pipped to pole position by a sensational final lap by Norris, predicted: "Probably it's going to be grandmother driving in the first 10 laps, but let's see.
"We saw in the long run how steep the degradation can be, especially if you push too early. We will try to see in the moment.
"Maybe we go into the race and the degradation is going to be much lower."
Why Norris is on the 'backfoot' despite pole
It seems track position could be critical, so, in theory, Norris is in the best position as he starts on pole ahead of Antonelli, Verstappen and Hamilton.
But, the McLaren driver missed almost all of second practice on Friday due to a gearbox issue and has not completed any meaningful long running as a consequence.
"I have to do my homework tonight. I'm on the backfoot from a high fuel perspective. I've not done any," Norris told Sky Sports F1.
Lando Norris describes his lap which claimed him Spanish GP pole as one of his best
"I need to use the data we have from Oscar and see what uses I can have, looking at onboard videos and data from everyone.

"Not an ideal situation but I gave myself the best chance and we will prepare the best way possible. Luckily it's not the best track to overtake on, so we will focus on a good start, good lap one and see what we can do."

In Friday's practice sessions, the tyre degradation was extremely high due to the successive high-speed corners, including the big banked 'La Monumental' Turn 12 where the tyres experience high loads.
"Everyone found out there was a lot of graining on the tyres," said McLaren team principal Andrea Stella.
"I'm not sure everyone has clear ideas as to what strategies we have ahead of us, so it will be entertaining."

“I think hanging it out for a one-stop, if you think of Monaco, you can go slowly, manage the tyres and not get that graining through [the banked] Turn 12. Perhaps you can extend the life of the tyres and make a one-stop work.
“But if overtaking is possible, because of high tyre degradation, you won’t be able to drive slowly enough to make that happen.
"At this stage I see it being a two-stop race and a disruptive race."
The pace between the front-runners should be close, so the race is likely going to come down to tyre degradation, which will dictate how much overtaking there is.

Norris is in the best position, as he can control the pace, but if overtaking is possible, he cannot afford to drive too slowly to save his tyres. But that's the big question mark, is there enough room to overtake?
"The only thing you can do is try to put pressure on the car in front, trying to make them make a mistake or make them deg a bit more, and then you try to play with strategy," said Antonelli.

detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯“震惊”地从基米·安东内利手中抢下F1西班牙站杆位
兰多·诺里斯在F1西班牙大奖赛中击败基米·安东内利，盛赞这是“我职业生涯最佳圈之一”
卫冕F1世界冠军兰多·诺里斯表示，他对在新马德里赛道（马德里赛道）举行的首场比赛中夺得杆位感到震惊。他在高速的马德里赛道上跑出“职业生涯最佳圈之一”，击败了积分榜领先者基米·安东内利。
在一场激动人心的排位赛尾声，安东内利率先出场进行最后一组飞驰圈，一度看似将拿下杆位，从而收获本赛季第七个杆位。
当其他对手无法跟上这位意大利车手时，迈凯伦车手诺里斯以仅0.011秒的优势力压这位梅赛德斯年轻车手，跑出1分31.824秒的杆位圈速。
“我很震惊。我现在有点惊讶能在这里，”兴高采烈的诺里斯在拿下本赛季第三个杆位、也是最近四场大奖赛中的第三个杆位后说道。
“天哪，这可能是我职业生涯中跑出的最佳圈之一。我非常、非常开心，非常自豪，为车队感到非常高兴。就是那种一切完美结合的圈。
“我很清楚自己想做什么，但问题在于最后一圈我的大脑是否允许我做到，而一切几乎完美地实现了。我就是非常开心。就是那种你看到最终圈速时，会想‘哦，该死，这相当不错’的圈。”
5.4公里长的马德里赛道因其类似吉达的高速弯角与墙壁距离极近的组合而让车手们感到害怕，这留下了零容错空间。这也使它成为赛历上更适合全力冲刺排位赛的赛道之一。
“最后一圈肾上腺素飙升，”诺里斯报告说。“就是那种你必须放松，让一切自然流动的圈。
“在这里很容易变得紧张，有很多墙壁会很快向你逼近。我只是好好吸了口气，一切就都融合在一起了，所以几乎完美。
“到最后一个弯角时，我以为我撞墙了，我以为伙计们今晚得修车了。”
detailEn: Lando Norris "shocked" to snatch F1 Spanish GP pole from Kimi Antonelli
Lando Norris hails "one of my best laps ever" as he defeats Kimi Antonelli at Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix

Reigning Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris said he was shocked to take pole for the first-ever race on the new Madring circuit, putting in "one of the best laps of my career" to take down championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

At the end of a thrilling qualifying session, Antonelli went out first for the final set of flying laps around the high-speed Madring track and looked set to take his seventh pole of the campaign by going fastest.
As other rivals failed to keep up with the Italian, McLaren driver Norris pipped the Mercedes youngster by just 0.011s to set a 1m31.824s pole lap.
"I'm shocked. I'm a little bit surprised to be here now," an elated Norris said as he took his third pole of the campaign, and his third in four grands prix.
"My god, it was probably one of the best laps I've done ever in my career. I'm very, very happy, very proud, very happy for the team. It was just one of those laps where everything came together.

"I had a good idea of what I wanted to do, but it was whether my brain let me do it on the last lap, and everything pretty much worked perfectly. I'm just very happy. One of those laps where you look at the lap time at the end, and you're like. 'Oh, shit, that was pretty good."

The 5.4km Madring circuit spooked the drivers because of its Jeddah-like combination of high-speed corners and close proximity of the walls, which left zero room for error. That also made it one of the more enjoyable tracks on the calendar for an all-out qualifying lap.
"The adrenaline was high on the last lap;" Norris reported. "It's just one where you've just got to relax, just let it all flow.
"It's easy to get tense around here, and there's a lot of walls that come at you pretty quickly. I just took a good breath, and everything kind of came together, so it was pretty much perfect.
"By the last corner, I thought I was in the wall, and I thought the boys were going to have to repair the car tonight."

这是诺里斯本赛季的第三个杆位，也是最近四场大奖赛中的第三个。

items.originalTitle: 诺里斯克服变速箱故障，夺马德里环西班牙大奖赛杆位
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris beat Formula 1 points leader Kimi Antonelli to take pole position for the Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯在马德里环赛道举行的2026年西班牙大奖赛排位赛中，以0.011秒的优势从F1积分榜领先者基米·安东内利手中夺走杆位，排位赛的收官阶段令人窒息。
在Q3第一轮飞驰圈后，法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿以1分32.079秒暂列杆位，领先于梅赛德斯车手，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘以及迈凯伦车队的诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里则等到本节最后时刻才做出最终的飞驰圈。
诺里斯——他在Q2排名第七，Q1排名第五——在Q3的最后时刻跑出1分31.824秒，他在Q2和Q3之间找到了1秒的圈速。
在拿下2026年第三个杆位后，他说这“可能是我做过的最好的圈之一”。
维斯塔潘在时间耗尽时有所提升，但在最后一段损失了时间，最终排名第三，落后安东内利，落后诺里斯的成绩0.140秒。
汉密尔顿在第一段损失了时间，但仍有所提升，最终排名第四，落后杆位0.189秒。
夏尔·勒克莱尔仅落后法拉利队友汉密尔顿0.006秒，位列前五。
梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔在最后一圈最后一个弯角滑出，损失了时间，最终排名第六。他在Q1表现冠绝全场后速度下滑，Q2也仅排名第六。
皮亚斯特里全程不在状态，最终排名第七，落后杆位的队友0.470秒。
另一辆红牛赛车由利亚姆·劳森驾驶，落后近半秒，排名第八。
阿尔派车队的弗兰科·科拉平托在Q2于La Monumental弯触底后救回赛车，最终锁定第九位发车，他在Q3中落后领先者1秒。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德再落后0.2秒，为小红牛车队排名第十。
在Q2中，维斯塔潘以1分32.431秒领跑，领先安东内利0.160秒。
在速度陷阱中排名靠前的奥迪车队在Q2被淘汰，尼科·霍肯伯格排名第11，加布里埃尔·博托莱托再落后0.165秒，排名第12。
蒙扎杆位得主皮埃尔·加斯利在Q2因双黄旗损失了一个圈速，最终排名第14被淘汰。他在无线电中说：“与[FP3]相比，这是一辆完全不同的车，我不明白。”
回放还显示加斯利在进入16号弯时擦到了墙。
小红牛车队的角田裕毅在Q2因赛道限制被删除一个圈速，未能充分提升。他排名第15被淘汰，领先威廉姆斯的亚历克斯·阿尔本一位——阿尔本在Q2中落后最快圈速3.101秒。
马德里人卡洛斯·塞恩斯在Q1排名第17被淘汰，他的圈速仅比威廉姆斯队友阿尔本慢0.005秒——阿尔本因悬挂损坏错过了FP3。
两辆阿斯顿·马丁均在Q1被淘汰：费尔南多·阿隆索（第18）以0.076秒之差落选，兰斯·斯特罗尔因疑似水压问题未能完成飞驰圈。
斯特罗尔将因引擎罚退从队尾发车。
两辆凯迪拉克相差两秒，塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯排名第19，瓦尔特利·博塔斯排名第20。
奥利·贝尔曼因FP3撞车未能在Q1做出圈速，考虑到他的哈斯赛车的潜力，他称这“很遗憾”。
10 阿尔维德·林德布拉德（小红牛）+1.217秒
11 尼科·霍肯伯格（奥迪）+0.019秒（至Q3）
17 卡洛斯·塞恩斯（威廉姆斯）+0.005秒（至Q2）
18 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+0.081秒
detailEn: Lando Norris snatched pole position for the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix from Formula 1 points leader Kimi Antonelli by just 0.011s in a breathless finale to qualifying at the Madring.

With Lewis Hamilton on provisional pole for Ferrari (1m32.079s) ahead of the Mercedes drivers after the first Q3 runs, Red Bull's Max Verstappen and the McLarens of Norris and Oscar Piastri waited until the very end of the session to set their final flying laps.
Norris - who was seventh in Q2 then fifth in Q1 - put in a lap of 1m31.824s right at the very end of Q3 as he found a second of laptime between Q2 and Q3.
He said it was "probably one of the best laps I've ever done" after taking his third pole position of 2026.
Verstappen improved as the clock ran out, but lost time in the final sector to qualify third, behind Antonelli, and 0.140s off Norris's pace.
Hamilton lost time in the first sector but still improved, only to qualify fourth and 0.189s off pole.
Charles Leclerc was just 0.006s behind Ferrari team-mate Hamilton as he rounded out the top five.

Mercedes' George Russell slid out of the final corner on his final effort, losing time and finishing sixth. His pace fell away after a table-topping performance in Q1, as he also finished sixth in Q2.
Piastri was off the pace throughout and finished seventh, 0.470s off his polesitting team-mate.
The other Red Bull of Liam Lawson was almost half a second off in eighth.
Alpine's Franco Colapinto rescued his car after it bottomed out at La Monumental in Q2 as he went on to secure ninth on the grid, having been one second off the pace in Q3.
Arvid Lindblad was two tenths further behind as he put his Racing Bulls 10th.
In Q2, Verstappen set the pace (with a 1m32.431s) to go 0.160s clear of Antonelli.
The speed trap-topping Audis were eliminated in Q2, with Nico Hulkenberg 11th and Gabriel Bortoleto another 0.165s off in 12th.

Monza polesitter Pierre Gasly lost a laptime to double yellows in Q2 and was eventually eliminated in 14th. "Compared to [FP3] it's a completely different car, I don’t get it," he said over the radio.
Replays also showed Gasly tapping the walls on the entry to Turn 16.

Racing Bulls's Yuki Tsunoda had a laptime deleted for track limits in Q2 and could not improve sufficiently. He was eliminated in 15th, one place ahead of Williams's Alex Albon - who was 3.101s off the ultimate pace in Q2.
Madrilenian Carlos Sainz was eliminated in 17th in Q1, having lapped just 0.005s slower than Williams team-mate Albon - who missed FP3 with suspension damage.
Both Aston Martins were eliminated in Q1: Fernando Alonso (18th) missed out by 0.076s and Lance Stroll did not execute a flying lap due to a suspected water pressure issue.
Stroll is set to start at the back of the grid with engine penalties.
The Cadillacs were split by two seconds with Sergio Perez 19th and Valtteri Bottas 20th.
Ollie Bearman failed to turn a lap in Q1 due to his FP3 crash, calling that a "shame" given the potential of his Haas.
10 Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) +1.217s
11 Nico Hulkenberg (Audi) +0.019s (to Q3)
17 Carlos Sainz (Williams) +0.005s (to Q2)
18 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +0.081s
keyPointsZh: 诺里斯在Q3最后时刻做出1分31.824秒，以0.011秒优势击败安东内利。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在最后一圈提升，但在最后一段损失时间，最终排名第三，落后诺里斯0.140秒。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在第一节损失时间但仍提升，最终排名第四，落后杆位0.189秒。
keyPointsEn: Norris set a 1m31.824s at the very end of Q3 to beat Antonelli by 0.011s.
Max Verstappen improved on his final lap but lost time in the final sector, qualifying third, 0.140s off Norris.
Lewis Hamilton lost time in the first sector but still improved, qualifying fourth, 0.189s off pole.

detailZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：兰多·诺里斯在马德里赛道赛道惊艳夺杆
这位迈凯伦车手在全新马德里赛道赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛一场惊心动魄的排位赛中，击败F1积分榜领先者基米·安东内利
卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯在F1西班牙大奖赛上夺得个人本赛季第三个杆位，在F1首次造访马德里赛道赛道时击败积分榜领先者基米·安东内利。
凭借最后一搏，诺里斯仅以0.011秒的优势压过安东内利的标杆圈速，让梅赛德斯连续第四次在排位赛中落败。
这是F1首次在这条位于西班牙首都马德里郊外的全新马德里赛道赛道上进行排位赛，这条充满挑战的5.4公里赛道融合了街道赛段和一条高速专用环道，缓冲区很小。
尽管此前有人担心排位赛会因事故和交通问题而受阻，但整场排位赛并未出现值得注意的意外。
在决定性的Q3对决中，法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿在第一轮飞驰圈后以1分32秒079的圈速领先，排在梅赛德斯双雄安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔以及他的队友夏尔·勒克莱尔之前。红牛在整个排位赛中也展现出竞争力的迹象，马克斯·维斯塔潘是另一个杆位竞争者，但这位荷兰人在第一轮飞驰圈结束时出现失误，最终只能排在两辆迈凯伦之前位列第五。
安东内利作为领先集团中第一个出场的车手，以1分31秒835的成绩从汉密尔顿手中接过榜首位置，他的大多数对手对此都无能为力。但诺里斯做到了，他在最后一个弯角漂移出弯，跑出1分31秒824的杆位圈。
维斯塔潘在红牛本周末早些时候表现挣扎之后，于这场令人意外地具有竞争力的排位赛中位列第三，法拉利双雄汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔分列第四和第五。另一辆梅赛德斯中，拉塞尔只能排在第六，其后是奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。利亚姆·劳森、弗兰科·科拉平托和阿尔维德·林德布拉德跻身前十。
Q2第一轮飞驰圈中，尼科·霍肯伯格和林德布拉德在F1中游集团中暂居Q3席位，让各自队友加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托和角田裕毅处于淘汰边缘。阿尔派的两辆赛车皮埃尔·加斯利和科拉平托在未能完成第一轮飞驰圈后也承受压力，后者在极具观赏性的高速Monumental倾斜弯中赛车尾部甩出，惊险逃过一劫。
科拉平托稳住心态，完成了一个稳健的最后一圈，为这位阿根廷人赢得第八名的Q3席位，排在迈凯伦的皮亚斯特里之前。维斯塔潘在这节排位赛中领先安东内利，林德布拉德是另一辆闯入Q3的中游赛车，将两辆奥迪淘汰出局。
埃斯特班·奥康为哈斯车队排在第13位，而沮丧的加斯利在抱怨赛车平衡与三练相比发生剧变后，只能排在第14位。角田裕毅和阿尔本分列第15和第16位。
在早些时候的Q1中，拉塞尔领先，在排位赛结束时以0.056秒的优势压过队友安东内利，他在与护墙发生轻微碰撞后毫发无损。
红牛在Q1中看起来特别有竞争力，劳森使用软胎位列第三，维斯塔潘使用中性胎位列第四，这让荷兰人得以省下一套软胎留待后续使用。法拉利车手汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔采用相同策略，各自占据前七名中的一个席位。
成绩榜末尾一如既往，威廉姆斯再次处于Q2席位的边缘。阿尔本仅以0.005秒的优势击败队友、主场宠儿卡洛斯·塞恩斯，以第16名抢到最后一张Q2门票，这位英泰混血车手从三练中撞墙、被迫缺席该节大部分时间的挫折中恢复过来。
不过塞恩斯仍是排名最高的西班牙车手，因为阿斯顿·马丁几乎没有进步，费尔南多·阿隆索排在第18位。凯迪拉克的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯和瓦尔特利·博塔斯在做出圈速的20辆赛车中垫底，博塔斯在被塞恩斯阻挡后未能完成一个干净的圈速。
排位赛在没有哈斯车手奥利弗·贝尔曼的情况下开始。这位“心如死灰”的贝尔曼在周六推迟的三练结束时遭遇严重撞车，哈斯面临一场不可能的战斗，要在排位赛前及时修复这位英国人的赛车。
兰斯·斯特罗尔是另一位未在马德里赛道赛道做出圈速的车手，原因是阿斯顿·马丁所称的疑似水压问题。无论如何，这位加拿大人还将因超出本赛季本田动力单元配额而面临队尾发车处罚。

detailEn: F1 Spanish GP: Lando Norris takes stunning pole at Madring
The McLaren driver defeats F1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli in a thrilling qualifying session at the Spanish Grand Prix on the brand-new Madring circuit
Reigning world champion Lando Norris claimed his third pole of the season at Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix, beating series leader Kimi Antonelli on F1's first-ever visit to the Madring circuit.
With a last-ditch effort, Norris took a mere 0.011s out of Antonelli's benchmark to hand Mercedes its fourth consecutive qualifying defeat.

It was F1's first-ever qualifying session on the brand-new Madring circuit on the outskirts of Spanish capital Madrid, a challenging 5.4km circuit featuring a mixture of street sections and a high-speed purpose-built loop with little runoff areas.
But despite worries qualifying would be derailed by accidents and traffic woes, the session took place without noteworthy hiccups.

In the deciding Q3 shootout, Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton led the way after the first barrage of runs with a 1m32.079s lap, ahead of Mercedes duo Antonelli and George Russell, and his team-mate Charles Leclerc. Red Bull had also shown flashes of competitiveness throughout qualifying, with Max Verstappen another contender for pole, but the Dutchman slipped up at the end of his first flyer and settled for fifth ahead of the two McLarens.

Heading out first of the frontrunners, Antonelli took over top spot from Hamilton with a 1m31.835s effort, which most of his rivals didn't have an answer for. But Norris did, drifting out of the final corner to set a 1m31.824s pole lap.

Verstappen was third on a surprisingly competitive outing for Red Bull after the team had struggled earlier in the weekend, with Ferrari duo Hamilton and Leclerc in fourth and fifth. In the second Mercedes, Russell could only manage sixth followed by Oscar Piastri. Liam Lawson, Franco Colapinto and Arvid Lindblad completed the top 10.

The first set of Q2 runs saw Nico Hulkenberg and Lindblad take a provisional Q3 spot in F1's midfield, leaving their respective team-mates Gabriel Bortoleto and Yuki Tsunoda on the bubble. Both Alpines of Pierre Gasly and Colapinto also came under pressure after not being able to complete their first flyer, with the latter surviving a huge scare as the back-end of his Alpine stepped out through the spectacularly fast Monumental banking.

Colapinto gathered himself to execute a solid final lap that netted the Argentinian a Q3 berth in eighth, ahead of McLaren's Piastri. As Verstappen topped the session from Antonelli, Lindblad was the other midfield car to make it through at the expense of the two Audis.
Esteban Ocon qualified 13th for Haas, while a frustrated Gasly could only manage 14th after lamenting a radically different car balance compared to FP3. Tsunoda and Albon followed in 15th and 16th.
Earlier in the session, Russell led the way in Q1, pipping team-mate Antonelli at the end of the session by 0.056s as he survived a tap with the wall unscathed.

Red Bull looked particularly competitive in Q1, with Lawson a close third on softs and Verstappen was fourth on the medium tyres, allowing the Dutchman to save a set of softs for later on. Ferrari drivers Hamilton and Leclerc followed the same strategy as they each claimed a top seven spot.

It was business as usual at the bottom of the timesheets, with Williams once again on the cusp of a Q2 spot. Albon beat team-mate and crowd favourite Carlos Sainz by a mere 0.005s to grab the final Q2 ticket in 16th, the Anglo-Thai driver bouncing back from a tap with the wall in FP3 which forced him to sit out the majority of the session.

Sainz was still the highest-placed Spaniard, though, as there was little improvement for Aston Martin with Fernando Alonso qualifying in 18th. Cadillac's Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas finished at the bottom of the 20 cars setting a lap time, with Bottas unable to complete a clean lap after being impeded by Sainz.

Qualifying got underway without Haas driver Oliver Bearman. A "gutted" Bearman suffered a heavy crash at the end of Saturday's delayed third practice session, as Haas faced an impossible battle to restore the Briton's car in time for qualifying.

Lance Stroll was the other driver not to set a lap time on the Madring circuit due to what Aston Martin called a suspected water pressure issue. The Canadian is set for a back-of-the-grid penalty anyway for exceeding his Honda power unit allowance for the season.
